verdict.rationale: First-party docs show task creation through the API (create, update and manage tasks programmatically, setting a task type at creation) and through Slack and Microsoft Teams, with Sprints listed as a planning feature. The evidence never mentions assigning tasks to teammates or setting due dates, so only the creation half of the story is covered. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of teammate assignment, explicit evidence of due-date setting, independent hands-on corroboration.
